painpoints.text: nu has no clean way to reuse pure defs from a script that also defines `main`: sourcing `scripts/qualitygate.nu` wholesale into `.fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/claim-check.nu` failed lint-nu with 'Duplicate command definition' on main (both files define one), and also broke claim-check-smoke which sources claim-check. Workaround was extracting the pair into `.fabro/scripts/lib/spec_paths.nu` (the seed_id.nu pattern). Suggestion: as more pure predicates are shared, grow `.fabro/scripts/lib/` deliberately and keep main-carrying scripts out of it — where (fabro-bf3c run): first lint-nu attempt recorded in the transcript as exit 1.

observations: The implementer-side spec-paths failure is prompt-mediated, not script-enforced: a non-compliant implementer could still route Implemented and the bounce would fall to the unchanged tester tier — the cheap lane catches the common case, the battery stays the guarantee. Files: `.fabro/workflows/loop/prompts/implementer.md`, backstop `scripts/qualitygate.nu` check-seed-spec-paths.

claim-check's degraded path (path gate skipped) still emits `spec-paths []`, so the implementer self-check degrades to vacuously green rather than dangling — same fail-open lane convention, in `.fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/claim-check.nu` main.

painpoints.text: Pin-parity drift slipped through despite the net: commit 76f423bef (chore: pin seeds 0.10.0) bumped .mise.toml alone and merged, so the parity fixture only fired at the NEXT loop-gate run (01M5JE7BE3GESN601QX66XWVB6 tester RED, costing a full implementer bounce). The battery has teeth but no pre-merge trigger; suggestion: wire .fabro/scripts/tool-pin-parity-fixtures.nu (or a one-line version-compare variant) into justfile's default lint target or a pre-push recipe so the drift fires at the author's desk, not in a loop run.

observations: The new implementer spec-paths self-check caught a real false-RED in its first live use: the seed's own Basis line cites .fabro/revisions/01M5CVG6XT9ABZFTMGY45QGCKT.md, which spec-named-loop-paths treated as an edit mandate — exactly the provenance class the journal exclusion (fabro-6b0f) already documents; fixed by extending the exclusion to .fabro/revisions/ in the same pass.

painpoints.text: The run-scope-fixtures drift pin textually scans qualitygate.nu for the loop-asset strings, so the shared-lib extraction in run 01M5JE7BE3GESN601QX66XWVB6 shipped with the battery RED — a one-unit edit that moved a def left its pin behind. Fix idea (where it hurt: .fabro/scripts/run-scope-fixtures.nu:103): the implementer prompt's one-unit bullet for extraction-style seeds should name 'update every textual pin that anchors the moved def' explicitly, or the pin should key on the lib path so moves are location-stable.

observations: The drift pin's failure message said 'loop-asset? set changed' when the set had not changed at all — only its file location had; a pin message that distinguishes moved-def from changed-set would have saved a re-derivation pass.
